items.text: LUNA, a K-pop virtual idol: long deep-violet hair in a high braided ponytail with silver chain accents, white sleeveless mock-neck zip crop top, white cargo mini-skirt with black belt and hanging chain, black thigh strap on left leg, chunky white platform sneakers with white crew socks, silver bracelets on right wrist
anime cel-shaded, clean line art, K-pop MV aesthetic, neon backlight, cinematic lighting; 16:9; high-detail generated video
items.note: migrated from shots.json defaults.style_suffix + aspect ratio

items.text: every automated cut lands exactly on a bar line; hard cuts are the grammar of this edit
motion snaps on the 106 BPM downbeat; poses land on beats, not between them
a vast empty arena interior in near-total darkness; a single stage at its centre, faint cold architecture barely traceable at the edges; no crowd, no props, air perfectly still
a packed live-arena stage at full performance power: towering light rigs, LED floor, haze, spotlight banks, walls of light behind the performer, audience pit swelling below the stage edge
a night city street, neon signage reflecting off wet asphalt; glass skyscrapers with holographic billboards, anonymous pedestrians blurred in the far distance
a colossal holographic billboard across the street, projector banks at its base, its surface rendering a life-size human face in scanlines
backup dancer silhouettes in strict formation behind her on stage, moving in sync
an ocean of glowing light sticks in the audience pit, waving in sync with the beat
the billboard's projected face is fracturing now: scanlines tearing, colour channels splitting apart, shards of light drifting off the surface
loose hologram shards dissolving in the air around her, fading like spent memories
the arena stripped to a single warm overhead wash: stage floor empty, rigs dark, crowd gone, back wall black
near-total blackout on the arena: one hard overhead beam on the performer, everything else void
the arena lights dying away one bank at a time in sequence, darkness closing in around her pose
single cold rim light carving the figure out of darkness; sparse, airy, almost no colour — the frame feels asleep
high-energy stage lighting: neon backlight, strobes, chromatic haze, saturated K-pop colour, cinematic contrast
wet neon city light: magenta and cyan signage reflecting on asphalt, shallow depth, city bokeh swimming behind the subject
single warm overhead wash, soft and intimate; sweat catching the light, gentle falloff into black
near-dark: one hard overhead beam on her face, everything else void black, fragile and exposed
lights dying bank by bank, deep shadows closing in; one cold key light on her until the logo flare freezes the frame
